name: plan2build
description: Plan2Build monorepo task runner (pnpm scripts replace the make targets in ENVIRONMENT_AND_DEPLOYMENT section 9)

scripts.local:houseplans:ruleset: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/local_houseplans.py seed-ruleset
scripts.local:reset-rate-limits: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/local_houseplans.py reset-rate-limits
scripts.local:logs: docker compose -f infra/local/compose.yml logs -f api worker
scripts.local:demo-rates: docker compose -f infra/local/compose.yml exec api python -m p2b.catalog.demo_rate_card
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format --check src tests migrations scripts && uv run ruff check src tests migrations scripts && uv run mypy src tests scripts && uv run lint-imports
scripts.contracts: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/export_contracts.py && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @p2b/contracts generate
